text:
Asha: FYI from this morning's call with ClearForm pilot, they put the pilot on hold because engineering can't map charges down to feature routes. Finance wants a downloadable ledger with route tags and iso timestamps.

Ben: Oof that's a renewal risk. Do they have a sample invoice or a required format?

Asha: They shared their AP team template (attached in intake: https://redwood.internal/cs/clearform_ap). It's pretty strict: columns for customer_ref, route_label, iso_ts, tokens, unit_price_usd, cost_usd, invoice_id.

Kai: Quick check, do our logs contain route_label today? If yes we can produce a CSV extractor. If not, we need a small schema change to normalize route ids at write time.

Riley: I looked earlier, logs have route_name in freeform but not normalized route_label. For a fast unblock we can run a backfill for ClearForm pilot from the last 30 days.

Asha: Customer agreed to a backfill as short-term fix, they want permanent change afterwards.

BillingBot: Automated ticket created -> CF-901: "ClearForm per-route ledger export" assigned to @Kai.

Ben: Suggested triage: severity = renewal_blocker (P0), frequency = 1 pilot, effort_shortterm = 2-3d backfill, effort_longterm = 5-8d infra change.

Kai: I'll scope the backfill. If route_name is present we can pivot to a 48h deliverable. I'll post a minimal CSV header prototype in the ticket:

```
customer_ref,route_label,iso_ts,tokens,unit_price_usd,cost_usd,invoice_id
```

Riley: Also flagging embeddings staleness note they mentioned in passing, but it's not blocking renewal. We'll log it as P2.

Asha: Action list:
- Kai: run 48h backfill + upload CSV to intake (due 48h)
- Ben: prepare finance mapping doc showing rounding and timezone rules (due 24h)
- Riley: add embeddings staleness note to backlog (P2)
- Asha: schedule post-delivery renewal check with ClearForm (after CSV delivered)

Kai: I'll start the backfill tonight and link results in CF-901. If we hit missing route_name cases I'll fallback to reconstructing using request_path heuristics and mark those rows as "inferred_route".

Ben: Good plan. For the finance doc I'll include a reconciliation test so ClearForm can validate totals against their invoices.

BillingBot: Reminder set -> follow-up on CF-901 in 3 days.

Asha: Thanks team, keeping this thread short so we can surface in the weekly CS->Product rollup.

Riley: :thumbsup:
